name: connect-tool
description: Set up and prove authentication for any CLI, MCP server, or Skill by driving the Chrome you are already logged into. Reconciles to a desired auth state (setup, refresh, broaden scopes, re-auth, repair), stores secrets in the macOS Keychain without the value entering the agent's context, and finishes only when a real authenticated call returns live data. macOS only. Markdown-only, no binary.
